query_analysis.original_query: I need to develop a comprehensive predictive model for solids discharge in our nozzle discharge solid-bowl centrifuge. What factors should we prioritize to minimize operational instabilities?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a predictive model to optimize the solids discharge process in a nozzle discharge solid-bowl centrifuge, identifying critical factors to enhance operational stability.

clarification_questions: What are the specific operational instabilities you are experiencing with the solids discharge process?
Are there any unique characteristics or challenges associated with your nozzle discharge solid-bowl centrifuge design?
What are the desired performance metrics or objectives for the predictive model?
